title: Gate Decision
description: A repository-level gate verdict recorded in harness/decisions.jsonl. This is a different artifact from contracts/decision.schema.json: a Growth Decision (DEC-) is a per-run product decision traced to evidence IDs, while a Gate Decision (dec-) records whether this repository may proceed through a build or release gate. The two contracts are intentionally separate so the append-only gate log is never rewritten to satisfy the growth-decision shape.

decision_id.description: Lowercase gate-decision identifier. Deliberately distinct from the DEC- growth-decision pattern.

gate.description: Which gate this verdict governs, for example build.

score.description: Optional rubric score. null records that no rubric score applies, and omission records the same absence.

reasons.description: At least one stated reason. A verdict without a reason is not auditable.

review_trigger.description: The condition that reopens this verdict. Required so no gate decision reads as permanent.

outcome.description: What actually happened after the gate. null until observed.

supersedes.description: The decision_id this record replaces, or null. Required so append-only history states its lineage explicitly instead of leaving it unstated.

scope_note.description: Optional boundary note stating what this decision does and does not approve.
